name: Hero
description: the hero: a tired, unimpressed man in his thirties with messy dark hair and a deadpan half-lidded stare, worn jacket and boots, a compact rocket launcher on his shoulder; exactly the look of his existing Idle sprite
notes: Hero clips for Docs/ArtPipeline.md. Cells match the existing hero sheets (604x340, Unity spriteScale 0.25) so he never changes size; every pose starts from the Idle reference. Written 2026-10-25 without GPU; wired into player.json animationConfig by the run.

poses.stand: standing relaxed, launcher on his shoulder, bored expression
poses.punchWind: leaning back with his right fist cocked behind him, launcher slung on his back, scowling
poses.punchHit: lunging forward, right fist fully extended, body low and twisted into the punch
poses.punchHook: left fist swinging round in a wide hook, shoulders turned
poses.punchUpper: rising on his toes with a fist driving upward in an uppercut
poses.launcherHeld: holding the rocket launcher on his shoulder, ready to fire
poses.launcherGone: hands empty and open at his sides, staring flatly at them
poses.dashLean: leaning hard forward mid-sprint, one leg stretched back, coat flaring
poses.wallCling: pressed against a wall on his right, one hand and foot on it, looking back over his shoulder
poses.wallKick: kicking off the wall, body arched out and up, arms spread
poses.grappleAim: arm thrown forward and up, holding a hook on a rope, other hand bracing
poses.grappleHang: hanging by one hand from a rope above him, legs swinging, bored
poses.ledgeHang: hanging by both hands from a ledge, legs dangling, grunting
poses.ledgePull: hauling himself up over a ledge, one knee on top
poses.grazeSpin: twisting out of the way with a smug smirk and a raised eyebrow, a tiny spark trailing his sleeve
poses.victoryPose: arms crossed, one eyebrow raised, the smallest nod of satisfaction
poses.deathFlat: flat on his back, eyes wide open, arms out, smoking

punch1.action: throws a quick right jab, then shakes out his hand

punch2.action: swings a wide left hook, grunting

punch3.action: rises on his toes into a big finishing uppercut

launcherAway.action: the launcher is yanked from his shoulder out of frame; he looks at his empty hands, unimpressed

equipLauncher.action: swings the rocket launcher up onto his shoulder and checks it

equipFists.action: slings the launcher on his back and cracks his knuckles

dash.action: bursts into a low forward dash, coat flaring

wallSlide.action: slides slowly down the wall, scowling

wallJump.action: kicks off the wall and launches up and away

grappleThrow.action: throws the hook up and forward on a rope

grappleSwing.action: swings back and forth hanging from the rope

ledgeGrab.action: snatches a ledge with both hands and dangles

ledgeClimb.action: hauls himself up and over the ledge

graze.action: twists aside as a shot whistles past, smirks smugly

victory.action: nods once, looks at the camera, flatly says 'fine' with a tiny fist pump

deathBurn.action: is hit, lights up like a firework, goes skeletal for a flash and collapses in a puff of smoke

deathSquash.action: looks up, sighs, and is flattened into a thin pancake which peels off the ground

deathSpin.action: is launched spinning into the air, waving goodbye at the top

deathShrug.action: shrugs, says nothing, and lies down on the ground to quit
